title: Seller launch: microcopy + preflight notes
content:
TL;DR:
Quick draft of tile/short copy variants + launch preflight checklist for the upcoming third-party seller tile on the cloud marketplace. Focus: clear 1-line value prop, short description (1-2 sentences), CTA variants, and technical/compliance gating items so Product, Legal and Eng have a single place to iterate.

Purpose:
- Ship an approved tile + page copy that communicates Redwood Inference's Hosted API + Dedicated options for partners with clear routing of support/billing.
- Ensure engineering readiness (metering, SKU, test accounts), legal/compliance sign-off, and marketplace asset checklist are accounted for before publish.

Audience:
- Platform/ISV buyers at mid-market and enterprise (technical decision-makers: infra/platform engineers, ML engineering leads).
- Channel partners evaluating commercialization and technical integration.

Goals / Acceptance criteria (high level):
- 1-line tile tagline that converts (A/B test two variants).
- Full listing copy (short + long) signed off by Legal.
- Technical preflight: test purchases succeed in STAGE, billing SKU created, usage metering events recorded, and a sample integration guide published.
- Support & escalation workflow documented in GH issues and linked to Customer Success.

Short tile tagline (3 variants):
1) Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference: low latency, predictable cost.
2) Fast, reliable LLM serving for product teams — hosted or private.
3) Scale LLM inference with predictable SLAs and cost controls.

Short description (for marketplace tile body; 1–2 sentences):
Variant A: Redwood Inference provides a developer-first API to run, optimize, and scale large language models with predictable latency and cost — choose Hosted API for fast onboarding or Dedicated pools for guaranteed throughput.
Variant B: Ship LLM features without the ops burden: low-latency REST/SDK access, model versioning, and cost controls for production workloads.

Long description (for listing page):
Draft: Redwood Inference is a production-first inference platform that helps product and ML teams ship LLM-powered features with consistent performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Our runtime is optimized for GPU-backed serving, automatic batching & KV caching, and provides observability and rollout tooling so you can maintain output quality while controlling cost. Integrates with existing CI, SSO, and KMS workflows.

Key bullets (feature highlights):
- Hosted API: fast onboarding, predictable per-token pricing, free credits for trial.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools, configurable autoscale, SLA-backed latency targets.
- Private: VPC and on-prem deployment options with KMS/HSM support.
- Console: per-route cost/latency breakdowns, tracing, rollouts (canary/A-B), and regression alerts.

Suggested CTAs (tile and page):
- Try free (10k tokens) — links to onboarding flow.
- Request Dedicated demo — routes to AE form.
- Contact Sales — enterprise SSO/KMS inquiries.

Microcopy rules / constraints (notes to copy writer):
- Avoid marketing hyperbole — emphasize predictability (latency/cost) and deployment options.
- Include short signal about data controls for enterprises ("data not used to train models unless opted-in").
- Keep the first sentence scannable (no more than 20–22 words).

Assets required (for marketplace submission):
- 1200x627 hero image (png, <1MB) — simple product screenshot + logo overlay.
- 600x600 tile image (png, transparent background).
- Short video (30–60s) overview (mp4).
- One-pager PDF for buyer download (feature matrix + pricing overview).
- Legal: privacy statement, DPA link, SOC2 snapshot (if available).

Technical preflight checklist (Engineering):
- [ ] Billing SKU created in marketplace portal and mapped to Redwood billing SKU: redwood.market.sku.hosted.
- [ ] Test purchase flow validated in STAGE region (eu-west-1 and us-west-2).
- [ ] Metering events: ensure marketplace metering webhook integration records tokens and embedding units.
- [ ] Support token provisioning: stage API key for partner test account created and rotated.
- [ ] Model variants: ensure fallbacks exist (faster/cheaper variant) and routing rules configured.
- [ ] Region coverage: list regions supported and map to marketplace listing.
- [ ] Billing reconciler: nightly job to reconcile marketplace invoices with internal usage events.
- [ ] Rate limiting/gating: ensure per-account quotas are enforced for trial tiers.

Security/compliance gating (Legal/Security):
- [ ] DPA + privacy language included on listing page.
- [ ] KMS/HSM support documented in product capabilities where relevant.
- [ ] Audit log sample and retention policy summarized.
- [ ] Any country-specific export control or regulated-data disclaimers added.

Operational runbook (short):
- Incident flow: marketplace storefront errors -> AE & Support pager -> Eng on-call (SRE).
- Escalation contact: go-to-market oncall alias + eng-sre oncall + partner success lead.
- Rollback: delist tile if critical billing/perf regressions for >4 hours.

Launch timeline (suggested sprint nuts):
- Week 0: GTM copy finalization + Legal review.
- Week 1: Asset collection (images, video, PDFs).
- Week 2: Engineering preflight + test purchases.
- Week 3: Marketplace submission + internal staging review.
- Week 4: Go-live + monitor first 72h metrics.

Owner matrix (who does what):
- Copy + creative: Aisha Patel (GT) + Lena Gomez (design).
- Legal review: Ethan Brooks (Legal).
- Engineering preflight: Marcus Chen (integrations) + Eng SRE (oncall).
- Partner Success training materials: Priya Nair (CS).

Open questions / To resolve before submit:
- Pricing: do we show list price or "contact sales for enterprise" for Dedicated? (Product to confirm).
- Trial limits: confirm free credit token amount and expiration policy.
- Marketplace-specific legal wording: does the marketplace require a localized privacy statement? (Legal to confirm).
- Metadata: need exact category tags and feature flags required by the marketplace metadata form.

Experiment ideas (post-launch):
- A/B test tagline A vs B during first week of traffic.
- Swap hero image with short video to measure CTR uplift.
- Offer limited-time marketplace credit to drive initial conversions (track conversion funnel).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is a rough working doc — please add inline comments. Keep microcopy short; we will create a final confluence doc with approved copy and asset links after sign-off.

References / links (working):
- Confluence entry: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/GT/marketplace-entry-578
- Jira: JIRA-GT-1342 (marketplace launch epic)
- GH onboarding PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-onboarding/pull/87

Quick checklist before submission (copywriter & product):
- [ ] Finalized 1-line tagline
- [ ] Short + Long descriptions approved by Legal
- [ ] All image/video assets uploaded to shared drive folder
- [ ] Billing SKU and test purchases green
- [ ] Runbook and escalation doc linked in listing notes

-- end of draft --

Notes-to-self: prioritize Legal checks for DPA language. Follow up with Marcus to validate metering webhook format and show sample payload in Confluence.
